title: Tasku Cloud — Task management for developers
excerpt: Back up and sync your Tasku tasks to the cloud. Free for individuals. Team collaboration available. Built for developers who live in the terminal.
content_html:
Now in beta — free while we build

Task management
that stays out of your way

Tasku Cloud backs up your tasks, keeps them in sync, and gives your whole team a shared view — without the bloat of a full project management suite.

New to Tasku?

Tasku Cloud is the companion to the free, open-source Tasku CLI. Install it first, then sign up to get your tasks backed up and in sync.

$ gem install tasku

Everything you need, nothing you don't

Built for developers who want a fast, focused task manager — not another bloated SaaS.

Cloud backup

Your tasks are safe in the cloud. Access them from any browser, any device, any time.

Same fields, familiar feel

All the fields from Tasku and Mado — status, priority, due dates, tags, and more — exactly as you know them.

Powerful filtering

Filter by status, priority, project, category, or due date. Find the task you're looking for instantly.

Light & dark mode

Your eyes, your choice. Toggle between light and dark mode with a single click.

Fast by design

No Electron, no heavy frameworks. Tasku Cloud is built to be snappy and keyboard-friendly.

Free to start

Sign up for free. No credit card, no trial period, no catch. Collaboration features coming soon.

Ready to get started?

Create your free account and have your tasks in the cloud in minutes.

Sign up free
